description: Event sourcing extension for Chaos.Mongo, providing aggregate-based event stores with MongoDB and opt-in tamper evidence: hash-chained event streams anchored with RFC 3161 timestamps.
releaseNotes:
# v1.0.0-rc.1 (2026-10-31)

### 💥 Breaking Changes

- Configure the integrity collection names with a prefix (#228) by @chA0s-Chris
- Align outbox and queue option names (#227) by @chA0s-Chris
- Trim the EventStore public API and reshape the integrity types (#226) by @chA0s-Chris
- Trim the public API of Chaos.Mongo (#225) by @chA0s-Chris
- Trim the Outbox public API (#224) by @chA0s-Chris
- Target net10.0 only and lower dependency minimums (#222) by @chA0s-Chris
- Add IServiceProvider-aware AddMongo overloads and MongoBuilder.ConfigureOptions (#195) by @chA0s-Chris
- Fix event store dropping members inherited from intermediate base classes (#187) by @chA0s-Chris
- Separate stream position from aggregate revision with store-assigned versions, revision-based concurrency, GetAtRevisionAsync and observational events (#166) by @chA0s-Chris

### ✨ Features

- Resolve queue payload handlers in a per-item DI scope (#229) by @chA0s-Chris
- Add tamper-evidence verification to the event store with a stable, independently verifiable format (#200) by @chA0s-Chris
- Add IServiceProvider-based publisher factory to the transactional outbox (#197) by @chA0s-Chris
- Confirm TSA revocation status with CRLs issued after the token time (#190) by @chA0s-Chris
- Store timestamp evidence of tamper-evidence anchors once, so large CRLs no longer stall anchoring (#191) by @chA0s-Chris
- Fix corrected event store registrations failing until restart after a rejected configuration (#189) by @chA0s-Chris
- Add transactional erasure of personal data from sealed events to the event store (#184) by @chA0s-Chris
- Add integrity anchoring with RFC 3161 timestamp authorities to the event store (#172) by @chA0s-Chris
- Track changed event streams for tamper-evidence anchoring (#170) by @chA0s-Chris
- Add tamper-evident per-stream hash chains to the event store (#161) by @chA0s-Chris

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Fix published outbox messages staying pending when the processor stops (#178) by @chA0s-Chris

### 📚 Documentation

- Complete the 1.0 reference documentation and add a testing guide (#233) by @chA0s-Chris
- Add 1.0 upgrade guide, compatibility policy and requirements (#232) by @chA0s-Chris
